verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission successfully landed on Friday, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean on Friday'; R2: 'today (April 10)'; R3: 'Friday, April 10, 2026'; R4: 'splashed down... at 5.07pm PT after a 10-day journey'; R5: '8:07 p.m. ET'; R6: 'April 11 at about 00:07 GMT (8:07pm ET on April 10)'
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm successful splashdown (water landing) on Friday, April 10, 2026.
